attributes._note_users: PINNED NOTE — the users[] at the bottom of this file are the DEFAULT BACKUP LOGINS, one per role: default-admin, default-analyst, default-auditor (passwords default-<role>-pw). They are seeded intentionally so every role always has a working break-glass login (e.g. if SSO provisioning or a normal account is misconfigured). SECURITY: change these passwords immediately on any real deployment, and DISABLE (set enabled:false) any role's default login you don't need. Normal users are NOT added here — an admin provisions them via the platform 'Create user' flow (POST /api/users/ → Keycloak Admin API) into the group matching their role. The groups[] and the tinyauth client ARE meant to be seeded here.

passwordPolicy: length(15) and upperCase(1) and lowerCase(1) and digits(1) and specialChars(1) and notUsername(undefined) and notEmail(undefined) and passwordHistory(5) and forceExpiredPasswordChange(60) and passwordBlacklist(dfir-platform.txt) and hashAlgorithm(pbkdf2-sha512) and hashIterations(210000)
